deliverables: Milestone-based disbursement controls through treasury management smart contracts
request.recipient: 2026 Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address stake1784sdxt6jjennmstphgdu7l7c2scf5d02a6cve2dgn5s2kq5u3j9v, with Intersect administering funds and Teragone identified as the vendor in the rationale.
request.what: Withdraw treasury funds for Mithril Protocol continued development through the Intersect budget process.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 3,810,423 ada, consisting of 3,699,440 ada for Mithril Protocol Continuous Development and 110,983 ada for the Intersect Budget Administration fee.
Mithril is presented as solving the cost and complexity of securely accessing and verifying Cardano blockchain state using stake-based threshold multi-signatures.
The proposal says Mithril enables rapid trustless state verification for nodes and applications without relying on the entire chain.
The proposal claims faster sync times lower onboarding friction and unlock tooling for exchanges, wallets, and monitoring.
The proposal states it achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase.
The proposal states the requested amount does not breach the applicable 350M ada Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 at the time of submission.
The proposal states audit, oversight, reporting obligations, and milestone-based disbursement controls are included through Intersect and technically capable third parties.
The proposal says Teragone has not previously received direct Cardano treasury or community governance funding but has worked on Mithril for several years through IOG funding.
The proposal specifies TRSC and PSSC addresses and says community tracking is available through a Sundae treasury dashboard and on-chain verification.
The proposal identifies an Oversight Committee of Sundae Labs, Cardano Foundation, Dquadrant, NMKR, Sundial, and Eternl with multi-party authorization requirements for key treasury contract actions.

summary: The document requests 3,810,423 ada for Mithril continued development and Intersect administration, frames Mithril as trustless infrastructure for faster state verification and reduced reliance on centralized services, and provides governance-process, NCL, smart-contract, dashboard, and audit references for verification.
